<h1 id="mybatis-plus进阶">MyBatis-plus进阶</h1>
<h2 id="映射">映射</h2>
<h3 id="自动映射规则">自动映射规则</h3>
<ol>
<li>表名和实体类名映射-》 表名user  实体类名User</li>
<li>字段名和实体类属性名映射-》字段名name   实体类属性名name</li>
</ol>
<p>这里需要注意：<strong>User类里的 private String name； 这个name不是属性名，而是变量名。</strong></p>
<p>那么什么是属性名呢？</p>
<p>类里面的属性对应的get方法，其方法名去掉“get”然后首字母小写对应的就是属性名，比如：</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">// 属性名是name 映射到数据库的字段是name
public String getName() {
    return name;
}
// 属性名是testName 映射到数据库的字段是testName
public String getTestName() {
    return name;
}
</code></pre>
<ol start="3">
<li>
<p>字段名下划线命名方式和实体类属性小驼峰命名方式映射-》</p>
<p>字段名 user_email   实体类属性名 userEmail</p>
<p>MyBatis-plus支持这种映射规则，可以通过配置来设置：</p>
<pre><code class="language-yaml">mybatis-plus:
  configuration:
    # 开启下划线到驼峰命名的映射
    map-underscore-to-camel-case: true
</code></pre>
</li>
</ol>
<h3 id="表映射tablename注解">表映射@TableName注解</h3>
<p>Pojo类通过@TableName注解指定映射的数据库表名，就会完成表名的映射。</p>
<p>@TableName注解主要应用在类名和数据库表名不一致的情况。</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">// 表示User类映射到t_user表
@TableName("t_user")
public class User {
    private Long id;

    public String getName() {
        return name;
    }

    private String name;
    private Integer age;
    private String email;
}
</code></pre>
<p>那如果数据库表特别多的情况下，这样每个类都指定具体表名会很麻烦，此时就可以开启表映射的全局配置。</p>
<p><strong>表映射的全局配置</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="language-yaml">mybatis-plus:
  global-config:
	db-config:
	# 全局配置表名的前缀，这样会自动将Pojo类名的首字母小，并且加上前缀t_
	# 这样就不用使用@TableName来指定表名
      table-prefix: t_
</code></pre>
<h3 id="字段映射">字段映射</h3>
<p>当数据库字段和表实体类的属性不一致时，可以使用@TableField注解改变字段和属性的映射，让注解中的名称和表字段保持一致。</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@TableField("user_email")
private String email;
</code></pre>
<p>此时的sql是：<strong>select id,user_email as email from user</strong></p>
<p>有一个<strong>问题场景</strong>：当数据库表中的某个字段设置为desc时，注意：desc为数据库的关键字，此时查询的sql语句就是：</p>
<p>select id,name,desc from user</p>
<p>很明显，这样的sql执行时会报错。那么怎么解决呢？</p>
<p>给关键字加上分隔符就能执行成功：select id,name,`desc` from user</p>
<p>在Java中 给desc这个属性加上注解@TableField("`desc`") 也就是字段名加上分隔符就可以了。</p>
<h3 id="字段失效">字段失效</h3>
<p>当数据库中有字段不想被查询时，可以使用@TableField(select= false)来隐藏这个字段。在拼接sql语句的时候就不会拼接这个字段</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">// 查询时不会查出Email这个字段
@TableField(select = false)
private String email;
</code></pre>
<h3 id="视图属性">视图属性</h3>
<p>实际开发中，有些字段不需要数据库存储，但需要展示，像这种实体类中存在但是数据库中不存在的字段，叫做视图字段。</p>
<p>这种字段可以通过@TableField(exist = false)注解来去掉这个字段，不让他作为查询或DML字段。</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@TableField(exist = false)
private String emailPhone;
</code></pre>
<h2 id="条件构造器">条件构造器</h2>
<p>MyBatis-plus的条件查询是基于面向对象的思想，条件查询使用对象来完成封装。</p>
<p><img alt="无2标题" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3388489/202603/3388489-20260311104053775-683438922.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>在实际开发中，只需要关注QueryWrapper和LambdaQueryWrapper这两个即可。</p>
<h3 id="等值查询">等值查询</h3>
<h4 id="eq-方法">eq 方法</h4>
<p>下面的两种查询方式的结果是一样的。</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">		// 使用 QueryWrapper
        QueryWrapper&lt;User&gt; wrapper = new QueryWrapper&lt;&gt;();
        // 设置条件 name=‘test2’
        wrapper.eq("name", "test2");
        User user1 = userService.getOne(wrapper);
        System.out.println(user1);

        // 使用LambdaQueryWrapper，这种方式可以避免字段名写错
        LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;User&gt; lambdaQueryWrapper = new LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;&gt;();
        lambdaQueryWrapper.eq(User::getName, "test2");
        User user2 = userService.getOne(lambdaQueryWrapper);
        System.out.println(user2);
</code></pre>
<h4 id="null的判断">null的判断</h4>
<p>当前端传来的查询条件为null时。此时用户希望不需要以此条件进行查询，我们就不需要进行查询拼接。</p>
<p>可以使用下面的方式进行判断处理：</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;User&gt; lambdaQueryWrapper = new LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;&gt;();
String name = "test2";
// 当name为null或者“”时，不作为查询拼接
lambdaQueryWrapper.eq(StringUtils.isNotBlank(name),User::getName, name);
User user2 = userService.getOne(lambdaQueryWrapper);
System.out.println(user2);
</code></pre>
<h4 id="多条件查询">多条件查询</h4>
<p>第一种方式：可以通过多个eq 来构建多条件查询</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;User&gt; lambdaQueryWrapper = new LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;&gt;();
String name = "test2";
lambdaQueryWrapper.eq(User::getName, name);
lambdaQueryWrapper.eq(User::getAge, 12);
User user2 = userService.getOne(lambdaQueryWrapper);
System.out.println(user2);
</code></pre>
<p>此时对应的sql是select * from t_user where name='test2' and age =12</p>
<p>第二种方式：allEq 方法，通过将查询条件封装在一个map中，然后调用allEq方法，实现多条件查询</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">HashMap&lt;String, Object&gt; hashMap = new HashMap&lt;&gt;();
hashMap.put("name", "test2");
hashMap.put("age", 12);
QueryWrapper&lt;User&gt; queryWrapper = new QueryWrapper&lt;&gt;();
 // 第二个参数表示，当map中的值为null时，不作为查询条件进行拼接
queryWrapper.allEq(hashMap,false);
User user3 = userService.getOne(lambdaQueryWrapper);
System.out.println(user3);
</code></pre>
<h3 id="ne-不等值查询">ne 不等值查询</h3>
<pre><code class="language-java">LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;User&gt; lambdaQueryWrapper = new LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;&gt;();
String name = "test2";
lambdaQueryWrapper.ne(User::getName, name);
List&lt;User&gt; userList = userService.list(lambdaQueryWrapper);
System.out.println(userList);
</code></pre>
<p>对应的sql：select * from t_user where name &lt;&gt; 'test2'</p>
<h3 id="范围查询">范围查询</h3>
<h4 id="gt-大于">gt 大于</h4>
<pre><code class="language-java"> 		LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;User&gt; lambdaQueryWrapper = new LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;&gt;();
        lambdaQueryWrapper.gt(User::getAge, 12);
        List&lt;User&gt; userList = userService.list(lambdaQueryWrapper);
        System.out.println(userList);
</code></pre>
<p>对应的sql：select * from t_user where age &gt; 12</p>
<h4 id="ge-大于等于">ge 大于等于</h4>
<pre><code class="language-java">LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;User&gt; lambdaQueryWrapper = new LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;&gt;();
lambdaQueryWrapper.ge(User::getAge, 12);
List&lt;User&gt; userList = userService.list(lambdaQueryWrapper);
System.out.println(userList);
</code></pre>
<p>对应的sql：select * from t_user where age &gt;= 12</p>
<h4 id="lt-小于">lt 小于</h4>
<pre><code>LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;User&gt; lambdaQueryWrapper = new LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;&gt;();
lambdaQueryWrapper.lt(User::getAge, 12);
List&lt;User&gt; userList = userService.list(lambdaQueryWrapper);
System.out.println(userList);
</code></pre>
<p>对应的sql：select * from t_user where age &lt; 12</p>
<h4 id="le-小于等于">le 小于等于</h4>
<pre><code>LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;User&gt; lambdaQueryWrapper = new LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;&gt;();
lambdaQueryWrapper.le(User::getAge, 12);
List&lt;User&gt; userList = userService.list(lambdaQueryWrapper);
System.out.println(userList);
</code></pre>
<p>对应的sql：select * from t_user where age &lt;= 12</p>
<h4 id="between-范围内">between 范围内</h4>
<pre><code class="language-java">LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;User&gt; lambdaQueryWrapper = new LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;&gt;();
// 查询年龄在12-36之间
lambdaQueryWrapper.between(User::getAge, 12,36);
List&lt;User&gt; userList = userService.list(lambdaQueryWrapper);
System.out.println(userList);
</code></pre>
<p>对应的sql：select * from t_user  where age between 12 and 36  查询结果包含年龄为12和36的数据。</p>
<p>notBetween 范围外</p>
<pre><code>LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;User&gt; lambdaQueryWrapper = new LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;&gt;();
// 查询年龄不在12-36之间
lambdaQueryWrapper.between(User::getAge, 12,36);
List&lt;User&gt; userList = userService.list(lambdaQueryWrapper);
System.out.println(userList);
</code></pre>
<p>对应的sql：select * from t_user  where age not between 12 and 36</p>
<h3 id="模糊查询">模糊查询</h3>
<h4 id="like">like</h4>
<pre><code class="language-java">LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;User&gt; lambdaQueryWrapper = new LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;&gt;();
lambdaQueryWrapper.like(User::getName, "张");
List&lt;User&gt; userList = userService.list(lambdaQueryWrapper);
System.out.println(userList);
</code></pre>
<p>对应的sql：select * from t_user where name like '%张%'</p>
<h4 id="notlike">notLike</h4>
<pre><code class="language-java">LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;User&gt; lambdaQueryWrapper = new LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;&gt;();
lambdaQueryWrapper.notLike(User::getName, "张");
List&lt;User&gt; userList = userService.list(lambdaQueryWrapper);
System.out.println(userList);
</code></pre>
<p>对应的sql：select * from t_user where name not like '%张%'</p>
<h4 id="likeleft">likeLeft</h4>
<pre><code class="language-java">LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;User&gt; lambdaQueryWrapper = new LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;&gt;();
lambdaQueryWrapper.likeLeft(User::getName, "张");
List&lt;User&gt; userList = userService.list(lambdaQueryWrapper);
System.out.println(userList);
</code></pre>
<p>对应的sql：select * from t_user where name like '%张'   查询name以’张‘结尾</p>
<h4 id="likeright">likeRight</h4>
<pre><code class="language-java">LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;User&gt; lambdaQueryWrapper = new LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;&gt;();
lambdaQueryWrapper.likeRight(User::getName, "张");
List&lt;User&gt; userList = userService.list(lambdaQueryWrapper);
System.out.println(userList);
</code></pre>
<p>对应的sql：select * from t_user where name like '张%'  查询name以’张‘开头</p>
<h3 id="判空查询">判空查询</h3>
<h4 id="isnull">isNull</h4>
<pre><code class="language-java">LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;User&gt; lambdaQueryWrapper = new LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;&gt;();
lambdaQueryWrapper.isNull(User::getEmail);
List&lt;User&gt; userList = userService.list(lambdaQueryWrapper);
System.out.println(userList);
</code></pre>
<p>对应的sql：select * from t_user where email is null</p>
<h4 id="isnotnull">isNotNull</h4>
<pre><code class="language-java">LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;User&gt; lambdaQueryWrapper = new LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;&gt;();
lambdaQueryWrapper.isNotNull(User::getEmail);
List&lt;User&gt; userList = userService.list(lambdaQueryWrapper);
System.out.println(userList);
</code></pre>
<p>对应的sql：select * from t_user where email is not null</p>
<h3 id="包含查询-in">包含查询 in</h3>
<pre><code class="language-java">LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;User&gt; lambdaQueryWrapper = new LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;&gt;();
ArrayList&lt;Integer&gt; arrayList = new ArrayList&lt;&gt;();
Collections.addAll(arrayList, 21, 22, 23);
lambdaQueryWrapper.in(User::getAge, arrayList);
List&lt;User&gt; userList = userService.list(lambdaQueryWrapper);
System.out.println(userList);
</code></pre>
<p>对应的sql：select * from t_user where age in (21,22,23)</p>
<h3 id="不包含查询-notin">不包含查询 notIn</h3>
<pre><code class="language-java">LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;User&gt; lambdaQueryWrapper = new LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;&gt;();
ArrayList&lt;Integer&gt; arrayList = new ArrayList&lt;&gt;();
Collections.addAll(arrayList, 21, 22, 23);
lambdaQueryWrapper.notIn(User::getAge, arrayList);
List&lt;User&gt; userList = userService.list(lambdaQueryWrapper);
System.out.println(userList);
</code></pre>
<p>对应的sql：select * from t_user where age not in (21,22,23)</p>
<h3 id="包含查询-insql">包含查询 inSql</h3>
<pre><code class="language-java">LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;User&gt; lambdaQueryWrapper = new LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;&gt;();
// 查询条件直接写死
// lambdaQueryWrapper.inSql(User::getAge, "11,12,13");
// 查询条件时一条sql
lambdaQueryWrapper.inSql(User::getAge, "select age from k_user where age &lt; 20");
List&lt;User&gt; userList = userService.list(lambdaQueryWrapper);
System.out.println(userList);
</code></pre>
<p>对应的sql：select * from t_user where age in (11,12,13)</p>
<p>​					select * from t_user where age in (select age from k_user where age &lt; 20)</p>
<h3 id="不包含查询-notinsql">不包含查询 notInSql</h3>
<p>调用方式与上面类似，这里不再举例</p>
<h3 id="分组查询-groupby">分组查询 groupBy</h3>
<pre><code class="language-java">QueryWrapper&lt;User&gt; wrapper = new QueryWrapper&lt;&gt;();
// 分组字段
wrapper.groupBy("age");
// 查询字段
wrapper.select("age,count(*) as field_count");
List&lt;Map&lt;String, Object&gt;&gt; mapList =  userService.listMaps(wrapper);
System.out.println(mapList);
</code></pre>
<p>对应的sql ：select age,count(*) as field_count from t_user group by age</p>
<h3 id="聚合查询-having">聚合查询 having</h3>
<pre><code class="language-java">  		QueryWrapper&lt;User&gt; wrapper = new QueryWrapper&lt;&gt;();
        // 分组字段
        wrapper.groupBy("age");
        // 查询字段
        wrapper.select("age,count(*) as field_count");
		// 聚合条件筛选
        wrapper.having("field_count &gt; 10");
        List&lt;Map&lt;String, Object&gt;&gt; mapList =  userService.listMaps(wrapper);
        System.out.println(mapList);
</code></pre>
<p>对应的sql ：select age,count(*) as field_count from t_user group by age having field_count &gt; 10</p>
<h3 id="排序查询">排序查询</h3>
<ol>
<li>orderByAsc 升序</li>
</ol>
<pre><code class="language-java">LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;User&gt; lambdaQueryWrapper = new LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;&gt;();
lambdaQueryWrapper.orderByAsc(User::getAge,User::getId);
List&lt;User&gt; userList = userService.list(lambdaQueryWrapper);
System.out.println(userList);

// 对应的sql ：select * from t_user order by age asc,id asc
</code></pre>
<ol start="2">
<li>orderByDesc 降序</li>
</ol>
<pre><code class="language-java">LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;User&gt; lambdaQueryWrapper = new LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;&gt;();
lambdaQueryWrapper.orderByDesc(User::getAge,User::getId);
List&lt;User&gt; userList = userService.list(lambdaQueryWrapper);
System.out.println(userList);

// 对应的sql ：select * from t_user order by age desc,id desc
</code></pre>
<ol start="3">
<li>
<p>orderBy 有升序有降序</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;User&gt; lambdaQueryWrapper = new LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;&gt;();
// 参数1：如果排序的字段值为null，是否还参与排序
// 参数2：是否是升序
// 参数3：排序的字段
lambdaQueryWrapper.orderBy(true,true,User::getAge);
lambdaQueryWrapper.orderBy(true,false,User::getId);
List&lt;User&gt; userList = userService.list(lambdaQueryWrapper);
System.out.println(userList);

// 对应的sql ：select * from t_user order by age asc,id desc
</code></pre>
</li>
</ol>
<h3 id="内嵌逻辑查询-func">内嵌逻辑查询 func</h3>
<pre><code class="language-java">LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;User&gt; lambdaQueryWrapper = new LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;&gt;();
// 根据不同情况来选择拼接不同的查询条件
lambdaQueryWrapper.func(new Consumer&lt;LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;User&gt;&gt;() {
    @Override
    public void accept(LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;User&gt; userLambdaQueryWrapper) {
        if (1==1){
            userLambdaQueryWrapper.eq(User::getAge,22);
        }else {
            userLambdaQueryWrapper.ne(User::getAge,22);
        }
    }
});
List&lt;User&gt; userList = userService.list(lambdaQueryWrapper);
System.out.println(userList);

// 对应的sql：select * from t_user where age = 22
</code></pre>
<h3 id="逻辑查询">逻辑查询</h3>
<ol>
<li>
<p>and</p>
<p>正常拼接默认就是and，比如:</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;User&gt; lambdaQueryWrapper = new LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;&gt;();
// 根据不同情况来选择拼接不同的查询条件
lambdaQueryWrapper.gt(User::getAge,12).lt(User::getAge,22);
List&lt;User&gt; userList = userService.list(lambdaQueryWrapper);
System.out.println(userList);

// 对应的sql；select * from t_user where age &gt; 12 and age &lt; 22
</code></pre>
<p>and的嵌套查询：</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;User&gt; lambdaQueryWrapper = new LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;&gt;();
lambdaQueryWrapper.eq(User::getName, "张三").and(u -&gt; u.gt(User::getAge, 22).or().lt(User::getAge, 20));
List&lt;User&gt; userList = userService.list(lambdaQueryWrapper);
System.out.println(userList);

// 对应的sql；select * from t_user where name = '张三' and (age &gt; 22 or age &lt; 20)
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p>or</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;User&gt; lambdaQueryWrapper = new LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;&gt;();
lambdaQueryWrapper.gt(User::getAge, 22).or().lt(User::getAge, 20);
List&lt;User&gt; userList = userService.list(lambdaQueryWrapper);
System.out.println(userList);

// 对应的sql；select * from t_user where age &gt; 22 or age &lt; 20
</code></pre>
<p>or 的嵌套查询</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;User&gt; lambdaQueryWrapper = new LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;&gt;();
lambdaQueryWrapper.eq(User::getName, "张三").or(u-&gt;u.gt(User::getAge,20).lt(User::getAge,30));
List&lt;User&gt; userList = userService.list(lambdaQueryWrapper);
System.out.println(userList);

// 对应的sql；select * from t_user where name = '张三' or (age &gt; 20 and age &lt; 30)
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p>nested</p>
<p><code>.nested()</code> 用于<strong>嵌套条件分组</strong>的核心方法，作用是将一组条件用 <code>()</code> 包裹起来，形成独立的条件块，避免多个条件之间的逻辑运算优先级混乱。</p>
<p>需求：查询 <code>age &gt; 20</code> 且（<code>name = "张三"</code> 或 <code>email 包含 "test"</code>）的用户。</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;User&gt; wrapper = new LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;User&gt;()
    .gt(User::getAge, 20) // 外层条件：age&gt;20
    .nested(qw -&gt; qw       // 嵌套分组：(name=张三 OR email包含test)
        .eq(User::getName, "张三")
        .or()
        .like(User::getEmail, "test")
    );
List&lt;User&gt; userList = userService.list(lambdaQueryWrapper);
System.out.println(userList);

// 对应的sql；select * from t_user WHERE age &gt; 20 AND (name = '张三' OR email LIKE '%test%')
</code></pre>
</li>
</ol>
<h3 id="自定义查询-apply">自定义查询 apply</h3>
<p>apply方法的参数是字符串，会跟在sql语句where的后面，在复杂查询的应用场景中使用。</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;User&gt; lambdaQueryWrapper = new LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;&gt;();
lambdaQueryWrapper.apply("id=1");
List&lt;User&gt; userList = userService.list(lambdaQueryWrapper);
System.out.println(userList);

// 对应的sql；select * from t_user where id = 1
</code></pre>
<h3 id="last-查询">last 查询</h3>
<p><code>last</code> 方法允许你直接在<strong>查询的最后添加一个 SQL 片段</strong>。</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;User&gt; lambdaQueryWrapper = new LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;&gt;();
lambdaQueryWrapper.last("limit 0,10");
List&lt;User&gt; userList = userService.list(lambdaQueryWrapper);
System.out.println(userList);

// 对应的sql；select * from t_user limit 0,10
</code></pre>
<p>注意：<strong><code>last</code> 方法只能调用一次，多次调用将以最后一次为准</strong>。比如：</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;User&gt; lambdaQueryWrapper = new LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;&gt;();
lambdaQueryWrapper.last("where age =22");
lambdaQueryWrapper.last("and name = '张三'");
lambdaQueryWrapper.last("limit 0,10");
List&lt;User&gt; userList = userService.list(lambdaQueryWrapper);
System.out.println(userList);

// 对应的sql；select * from t_user limit 0,10
</code></pre>
<h3 id="exists查询">exists查询</h3>
<p><code>exists</code> 方法用于在查询中添加一个 EXISTS 子查询。通过调用 <code>exists</code> 方法，可以将一个完整的 SQL 子查询作为 EXISTS 条件添加到主查询中。</p>
<p>exists表示当子查询有返回结果时才执行主查询，如果子查询没有返回结果，那么不执行主查询。</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;User&gt; lambdaQueryWrapper = new LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;&gt;();
lambdaQueryWrapper.exists("select id from t_user where age = 1");
List&lt;User&gt; userList = userService.list(lambdaQueryWrapper);
System.out.println(userList);

// 对应的sql；select * from t_user WHERE EXISTS (select id from t_user where age = 1)
</code></pre>
<h3 id="notexists查询">notExists查询</h3>
<pre><code class="language-java">LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;User&gt; lambdaQueryWrapper = new LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;&gt;();
lambdaQueryWrapper.notExists("select id from t_user where age = 1");
List&lt;User&gt; userList = userService.list(lambdaQueryWrapper);
System.out.println(userList);

// 对应的sql；select * from t_user WHERE NOT EXISTS (select id from t_user where age = 1)
</code></pre>
<h3 id="select查询">select查询</h3>
<p><code>select</code> 方法用于设置查询的字段。通过调用 <code>select</code> 方法，可以指定在查询结果中包含哪些字段，从而实现字段级别的查询定制。</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;User&gt; lambdaQueryWrapper = new LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;&gt;();
lambdaQueryWrapper.select(User::getId, User::getName, User::getAge);
List&lt;User&gt; userList = userService.list(lambdaQueryWrapper);
System.out.println(userList);

// 对应的sql；select id,name,age from t_user
</code></pre>


</div>
